seed: Objects of type `player` under action ACTION2 with touching neighbours [] show mixed outcomes: y x5, no_change x2. Find the condition in the before state that decides the outcome. Start from this kind of condition: a global object such as a counter, HUD element or legend, read as state. Verify it against every transition before you keep it.

synth.notes:
Player 5x5 moves 5 cells; dest box with wall colour 4 or off-board = blocked (still burns 2). The hinted A2 no_change is a wall below (34,5), not a global counter.
Colour-1 5-cell edge strip = conveyor: slide away from it until blocked ((9,5)->(34,5)).
Bar rows 61-62 colour 11 burns 2 cells from the left per action; fully covered refuel ring is consumed and refills the bar.
Fully covered collect object rotates the 3x3 HUD glyph 90deg CW and is hidden under the player; it is restored from a sprite cache that is used only when the incoming frame equals the last returned one.
Unconfirmed (not observed): recolor token sets glyph colour 9; dest near legend chamber while glyph != legend gives a free no-op.
